name: – Sabrina Repp – After § 49 – Am 16
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 49a. Expresses concern about the infiltration strategies carried out by certain organisations linked to political Islam within EU institutions; demands that the Commission establish strict and transparent conditionality in the granting of European funding for youth (such as under Erasmus+ and the European Solidarity Corps), in order to ensure that no public subsidies are paid to associations promoting separatism, Islamism or refusing to recognise the cultural heritage and values of European civilisation;
